name: Crochet Baby Romper Pattern | 0–12 Months
description:
Make this sweet little crochet baby romper for your little one. It has a simple design with shoulder straps and buttons, making it cute, comfortable, and practical for everyday wear.

Pattern Details:
• Sizes: 0–6 months and 6–12 months
• Skill level: Beginner / Easy
• Written in US crochet terms
• 3 mm crochet hook
• 100% cotton yarn recommended
• Digital PDF pattern

The romper is crocheted from the bottom up. You will make the two legs first, join them together, and then work the body, front and back sections, straps, and buttonholes.
The 6–12 month size is designed with a loose and comfortable fit, with straps and buttons to make dressing and diaper changes easier.

What You Will Need:
• 3 mm crochet hook
• 100% cotton yarn
• 2 stitch markers
• Tapestry needle
• 2 buttons
• Scissors
